sloka: तदलं परितापेन देवि मन्युर्व्यपैतु ते ।एकोत्पातेन वै लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः ।। ५.६८.२३ ।।।।
transliteration: tadalaṁ paritāpena devi manyurvyapaitu te ।ekotpātena vai laṅkāmeṣyanti hariyūthapāḥ ।। 5.68.23 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O noble lady give up your lamentation. Enough of sorrowing. The vanara army will fly and reach this place at one leap and fill it.
